notes.text:
An update is available for module.libzip, module.php-pecl-rrd, php-pecl-apcu, module.php-pecl-apcu, libzip, php-pecl-zip, module.php-pecl-zip, php-pecl-rrd, php-pear, module.php-pear, php-pecl-xdebug3, module.php-pecl-xdebug3.
This update affects Rocky Linux 8.
A Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) base score, which gives a detailed severity rating, is available for each vulnerability from the CVE list
notes.title: Topic

notes.text:
PHP is an HTML-embedded scripting language commonly used with the Apache HTTP Server.

Security Fix(es):

* php: ext-pgsql: PHP: SQL injection via improper backslash escaping (CVE-2026-17543)

* php: PHP: Denial of Service via circular symbolic links in phar archives (CVE-2026-7260)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* Rebase PHP to 8.2.33 for CVE-2026-17543 and CVE-2026-7260 in 8.10.z (JIRA:Rocky Linux-223938)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.

This advisory is provided by Ctrl IQ, Inc for Rocky Linux systems. For more information about CIQ security practices, visit https://ciq.com/security.
